sha: SET-AT-LAUNCH: branch idle-gap (45e152d, from 80b3bbd) rebased onto the fleet sha at launch
notes: Owner-approved tech-tree item 4. Both engines measured the fleet (24 h, 162k decisions) before building: idle = 25.3% of decisions; a rung was given up after 25 consecutive non-successes of ANY decision, 51% of them admission rejections; skipCount never reset (69% of skipped entries at the 6 h cap). THE CHANGE: only an executed (not rejected, not a runner refusal), serving (servesRung: the admission gate's output rules + a drop map + a verb map for route rungs; detours by their own wants) failure counts; a genuine completion (not a no-means or no-chest bypass) resets skipCount; exits: 45 min without serving progress, and 3 h current unmet (Codex's counterexample held a rung 6.6 h without it), persisted with a 10-min restart grace; no-progress/residence give-ups are never reported to peers; outcomes are charged only to the rung they were judged against. Analysis + implementation reviewed by Claude and Codex independently; all findings fixed (0e5ef8e, 45e152d). 19 tests, 15 anchored mutants killed, 204/204; sandbox smoke clean. A LADDER CHANGE: effect is reported, never gated -- the dry run shows idle share swinging +0.28 DiD on an unchanged pool in 2.4 h.

licence.note: The baseline writes 'no progress after 25 attempts; moved on to X' (232 control rows, 0 containing 'serving', in the 09-29 dry run). The canary writes '25 serving attempts failed' or 'no serving progress in 45 min'. ~32 skips per bot-day, so a 5-bot pool writes several within 3 h.

require.name: skips happening in the pool (the mechanism this changes)

draw_exposure.note: Claude review: draw from bots whose idle share is >= 15%. drawexposure counts kinds only, so require >= 5 skips in 3 h (placebo-c wrote 12 in 2.4 h) and the OPERATOR checks the drawn pool's pre-period idle share in the first read.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 1 canary skip in the new format AND >= 1 control skip.

own_lines.note: CORRECTNESS: a canary rung current longer than 3.5 h means the absolute bound did not hold (the dead end both reviews required an exit from).
Arms: the baseline cannot write `_milestone_skip_reset`. BLOCKS KEEP.
POSITIVE CONTROL (232 in the dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: idle share DiD (idle and idle+prereq), completions/bot-h DiD, skips by reason, residence p90/max (Codex: read the tails; a lower idle share could be longer futile occupancy), skip resets. Items/bot-h expected ~3% (safety only, via immobiledid's gather_ratio). Three things change at once (what counts, the exits, the reset) -- named, not separable on one pool.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.
